## DO NOT USE THIS TEMPLATE
This is just a reminder on how user stories should be made. To make an actual
user story: go to the project board, paste the user story in the text input bar,


## Story
**As a** (point of view)
**I want** (feature)
**In order to** (value)

## Priority, impact & effort
| | Level (High / Medium / Low) | Reasoning |
|---|---|---|
| **Priority** | | Technical or restriction-related reasoning for this priority |
| **Impact** | | Reasoning for this impact level |
| **Effort** | | Reasoning for why this takes this level of effort |

## Things to consider
When deciding whether this is a good user story, check it against the **INVEST** framework:
- **I**ndependent — can be developed without depending on other stories
- **N**egotiable — details can still be discussed, not a fixed contract
- **V**aluable — delivers clear value to the user
- **E**stimable — the team can reasonably size the effort
- **S**mall — small enough to plan and deliver with confidence
- **T**estable — has a clear way to confirm it's done
